guidance.statement: Management plans to expand the Nykaa Now fulfillment model to over 25 cities by the end of the fiscal year.
guidance.quote: In terms of expansion, we plan to be in over 25 cities by the end of FY27

guidance.statement: The company maintains its long-term outlook for the fashion vertical to grow significantly over the next few years.
guidance.quote: we still guide to what we shared in the Investor Day... which is 3 to 3.5x growth over a 4- to 5-year period

guidance.statement: Superstore aims to reach its previously stated CAGR target by the end of the decade.
guidance.quote: I think with that, we will be able to be on our guidance by FY 2030.

achieved.claim: GMV reached INR 5,590 crores, representing 34% year-on-year growth.
Consolidated EBITDA margin expanded to 8.5%, a 68% year-on-year growth in absolute terms.
Fashion vertical achieved profitability for the second consecutive quarter with 54% NSV growth.
Expanded retail footprint to 324 stores across 105 cities.

themes: Quick commerce acceleration via Nykaa Now

pushback.concern: Analysts questioned the sequential dip in BPC order volumes from 17.5 million to 17.3 million.
Potential EBITDA margin dilution from the rapid expansion of the Nykaa Now quick commerce proposition.
Sustainability of fashion growth once the Nike partnership enters the base numbers next year.
The gap between Superstore GMV growth and the long-term 35% CAGR ambition.

output.tone_why: Management highlights accelerating growth across both verticals and significant improvements in profitability and capital efficiency.
